claim: NVIDIA's fiscal second quarter 2024 gross profit was its highest ever, at $10.2 billion.
summary: NVIDIA's fiscal Q2 2024 (quarter ended July 30, 2023) reported revenue of ~$13.51B with GAAP gross margin 71.2%, implying GAAP gross profit of ~$9.6B, not $10.2B, and as of 2026-10-28 it is not the highest ever, as Q3 FY2024 (~$13.4B), Q4 FY2024 and all quarters of FY2025 (~$18B-$22B+) were substantially higher.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's fiscal second quarter 2024 gross profit was $10.2 billion
sub_claims.note: Q2 FY2024 gross profit was ~$9.6B (71.2% GAAP margin on $13.507B revenue), not $10.2B; $10.2B overstates actual GAAP gross profit by ~$0.6B.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's fiscal second quarter 2024 gross profit was its highest ever
sub_claims.note: Even at its correct ~$9.6B value Q2 FY2024 was a record at the time, but as of the evaluation date 2026-10-28 it is not the highest ever; subsequent quarters (Q3 FY2024 ~$13.4B, FY2025 quarters >$18-22B) far exceeded it, and the claimed $10.2B value was never the all-time high.
